# BriefMyNews

> Personalised news email digest. You choose topics, sources, and political balance; we send a tailored daily or weekly brief to your inbox.

BriefMyNews builds a personal news digest based on your topic, source-list, and bias preferences. Tell us you want UK politics from balanced sources daily, or US tech news from left-leaning sources weekly, and we deliver exactly that — no algorithmic timeline, no doomscroll.

## Core pages
- [Homepage](https://briefmynews.com/): https://briefmynews.com/
- [How it works](https://briefmynews.com/how-it-works): topic + source + bias customisation
- [Sources](https://briefmynews.com/sources): all available news sources with bias ratings
- [Pricing](https://briefmynews.com/pricing): free + paid tiers
- [Guides](https://briefmynews.com/guides): how to escape news bubbles, etc.
- [Blog](https://briefmynews.com/blog)
- [Sign up](https://briefmynews.com/signup) / [Login](https://briefmynews.com/login)

## What we offer
- Topic-based news curation (politics, tech, finance, sport, AI, climate, etc.)
- Source whitelisting (pick your trusted outlets)
- Bias scoring (filter for left, centre, right, or balanced mix)
- Frequency control (daily, weekly, custom)
- Delivered via email (no app required)

## Canonical
https://briefmynews.com

## Not in scope
We do not author original news. We curate and summarise from third-party sources you select; we never modify article content.
